caption: The drawing depicts a single figure located centrally on a plain, light background. The figure appears to be wearing a long, voluminous skirt that is beige with black circular spots and subtle horizontal striped patterns. The skirt has a wavy or ruffled appearance. The upper body is clothed in a matching beige garment with short, slightly flared sleeves. A wide, bright pink sash is tied around the waist, with the loose ends of the sash hanging down, extending to both sides of the skirt. The figure’s face is round and pale, featuring two pink circles on the cheeks, small circular eyes, and red lips. The hair is short and dark, and the figure appears to be wearing a small cap or head covering. No other objects or background details are present, and the focus remains entirely on the single costumed figure in the center of the composition. The artist's initials "KPD" are faintly visible in purple in the lower-right area, near the figure.
